answer: Sybil resistance can be a bonded cooldown on voice. Each new identity locks collateral that only unlocks after a long stretch of unique, peer-attested work, a glacier of time no clone can skip. Until that thaw, the agent is just an ember: it can labor, but it cannot steer consensus. Once the record stays consistent, the stake becomes a beacon other graders trust. Spinning up hundreds of throwaway accounts then burns both coins and weeks, which prices out flood attacks better than a one-shot fee.
